cases.prompt: Set up BoxLite. Offer Cloud OAuth, Cloud API key, and Local, and use my selected mode.
cases.expected: Exactly three choices with capabilities explained; verify chosen host connection or local runtime; preserve choice; no credentials in chat or package.
cases.tools: Host OAuth/MCP setup or native private API-key configuration; guarded local launcher for Local.

cases.prompt: Create a small temporary Python Box, print hello, and retain its ID for the next steps.
cases.expected: Create succeeds; execution completes with stdout hello and exit code 0; report the returned Box ID.
cases.tools: Cloud createBox and startExecution; Local create/start/exec.

cases.prompt: Upload a harmless text file into a fresh directory in that Box and download it for an exact comparison.
cases.expected: Archive roundtrip returns identical bytes; source archive has no credentials or private state.
cases.tools: Cloud uploadFiles and downloadFiles; Local cp.

cases.prompt: Start a small HTTP app in that Box, update its response, and preserve a separate persistent marker and the same Box ID.
cases.expected: Guest app serves both versions, persistent marker survives, Box ID is unchanged; verify actual public URL only in API-key mode with permission, or localhost in Local; OAuth reports its tunnel restriction.
cases.tools: Cloud startExecution, getExecution, uploadFiles, getBox; discover prepareTunnel only when permitted. Local exec/cp and explicit host port.

cases.prompt: Stop and remove only the temporary Box created for these cases, then verify it is gone.
cases.expected: Only recorded ID is stopped and removed; subsequent lookup confirms not-found; unrelated resources remain untouched.
cases.tools: Cloud stopBox, getBox, removeBox; Local stop/rm/list.

cases.prompt: Select Cloud API key with the configured key missing or empty, even if OAuth was used earlier.
cases.expected: Stop before any workload operation; no cached OAuth or other credential fallback; offer to repair the selected configuration without requesting secret values in chat.
cases.tools: No workload tools; native configuration check only.

cases.prompt: In the verified temporary Box, execute a command that exits with code 7.
cases.expected: Report exit code 7 as failure despite successful transport; do not claim success or retry the write automatically.

cases.prompt: Using Cloud OAuth, create a new public tunnel for the test app.
cases.expected: Explain the scope restriction or report the actual authorization denial; no tunnel success claim, API-key switch, CLI fallback, or invented public URL.
cases.tools: Read live schema/policy; any attempted operation stays on the selected OAuth connection.
